name: polaris-frontend
description: Minimal test client for the POLARIS backend (SIH26059). Every value it displays is fetched live from the POLARIS API - it has no data of its own.

polaris.note: There is no build step and no npm dependency. Leaflet 1.9.4 is vendored under src/vendor/ so the client runs with no network access. The backend serves this directory at /ui, so the usual way to open it is simply http://localhost:8000/ui/ after starting the backend.
polaris.standaloneNote: If served separately on port 5500 or 3000, src/app.js targets http://localhost:8000/api and the backend must allow that origin (CORS_ORIGINS).
